title: Stuck in a rage room with BILLIE EILISH!
description:
"Part of the serenity of being in a rage room is doing it alone," Billie Eilish tells us. "Doing it in front of an audience is... insane." But despite being joined by Greg James and our radio + camera crew, it's not long until the record-breaking musician - and now co-director of her new 3D tour movie 'Hit Me Hard and Soft' - gets into the swing of things. "Doesn't it feel good?!"

With topics hidden in the rubble, Billie is tasked with smashing up objects to reveal a new question, submitted by
